title: The Golden Skate Switch
intro: The rink's gleaming golden skate trophy has been swapped for a cheap painted copy during the couples' skate, and everyone was on the floor when it happened.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: I only skate backwards, and I never cheat at anything.

suspects.name: Marcus
suspects.line: I was busy teaching my cousin how to stop. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Juniper
suspects.line: I was in the bathroom wrestling a sock. Long story.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: The trophy case? I barely looked at it, honestly.

suspects.name: Tomas
suspects.line: My skates are fine, my memory is fine, and so is my pizza.

clues.text: Green hoodie threads were found along the entrance mat, but a camera timestamp shows that hoodie wearer never reached the trophy case. Green hoodie is ruled out.
A receipt stamped at the snack bar during the swap proves the snack bar visitor was never near the trophy. Snack bar is ruled out.
Smudged prints on the case show no gloves or tape, so the thief had bare hands when the trophy was lifted.
A red tracksuit fibre is snagged on the rink's exit gate, so the thief was wearing a red tracksuit during the swap.
